defaults.statement: This resource is tagged as a disaster-recovery standby. Being idle is what a standby is for, so its utilisation is not evidence of waste and CostSentinel proposes no action on it.
This resource is tagged as being held to satisfy a retention requirement. Deleting it would be a compliance matter rather than a saving, so CostSentinel proposes no action on it.
This resource is tagged as one that must keep running whatever its utilisation shows. CostSentinel proposes no action that would stop or resize it.
The client has explicitly placed this resource outside cost optimisation. It is reported so the spend stays visible, and no action is proposed.
